headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 23, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 16.30%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 8.95%. This results in an average alpha of 7.34%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 46.57%, contributing a dollar change of $465.71. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 9.39%, reflecting a more modest performance. The current outperformance against SPY serves as a useful signal during periods of macro uncertainty and market volatility. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
